# OrcaFlex Solver

OrcaFlex is a marine dynamics simulation package developed by Orcina for
modelling risers, moorings, and other marine structures.

## Capabilities

- Time-domain and frequency-domain analysis
- Nonlinear finite element solver for flexible lines
- Vessel motion coupling (RAO-based and coupled)

- [Pipeline Integrity](../concepts/pipeline-integrity.md) for corrosion assessment
